prompt: Where should I keep my emergency fund?
answer:
Your emergency fund should be kept in a high yield savings account. With this type of account you can easily access your money when needed for an emergency. 

Emergencies can happen at any moment in our lives. The COVID-19 pandemic has shown us how important having an emergency fund is. Having 3-6 months worth of expenses in an easily accessible high yield savings account can help you weather unexpected downturns in your life or in the economy.

For example, if you have a monthly expense of $5,000, you should have between $15,000 and $30,000 in your emergency fund. Some financial experts say you need six months of expenses in your emergency fund, but you know better than anyone what your monthly costs are. Are there any big ticket items coming up in the next 6 months? Do you have an upcoming wedding in the family where you are expected to contribute? Knowing what is coming up can help you decide how much to put into your emergency fund.

Worried that having so much money "sitting around" is a waste? Use a high yield savings account so you are still earning a little bit of interest on your money.

What should you do if you do not have an emergency fund? Open a high yield savings account today and start putting money aside. *Set it and forget it* by automating the transfer from your paycheck into this high yield savings account. You won't even miss what you don't see. Before you know it, you'll have built yourself a cushion that will help you weather life's little and big emergencies.
